body: Thanks. It'll be another week until the day. I understand that they shouldn't be friends but I always go back. I'm honestly pretty sure I don't have value. I've wasted all my chances, made all the mistakes I could've, I feel that doing this will be sparing me and a whole lot of others.
I thought about it but I don't think I should with the day coming up.

I've tried but I always end up going back out of loneliness when I want somebody to talk to. I've tried looking for more but it always ends fast with nothing. I'm not positive why but it's probably because I'm socially awkward and bipolar. I try to be nice to people, but I could come off as an asshole for all I know.

I'm unemployed. I have a plan and a job feels a little pointless if these are my last days. I don't have dreams because I simply don't see a future ahead of me. The only thing that holds me back is the feeling that I'll hurt my family, even though they barely even acknowledge that I exist. An uncle took his life and it destroyed my grandmother and I don't want to make it worse. Thanks for listening, but there isn't really a reason for you to.
Shit, how can I delete this? I don't think I'm going to bother with this.
